message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
reason: Standalone JUnit owns one executor; explicit finally shutdownNow then 5s await+assert establishes finite release. AutoCloseable.close uses unbounded wait and is deliberately replaced under BUG3177; exact two finite get5/tasks and cleanup postcondition retained, no application resource or container thread.

message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
reason: Rule is J2EE managed-webapp thread restriction. This exact source site belongs to standalone JUnit synthetic logger concurrency fixture, outside application/container; owner creates2 workers, submits2 finite memory calls, get5 both, finally shutdownNow/await5assert. No new product threads/backend/live request.
